# Qt Base 6.12.0 license texts

The 38 `.txt` files in this directory are copied byte for byte from
`qtbase-everywhere-src-6.12.0/LICENSES/` in the
[official Qt Base 6.12.0 source ZIP](https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.12/6.12.0/submodules/qtbase-everywhere-src-6.12.0.zip).

Source archive SHA-256:
`0529901575c413e34ded504eeda177c4a6dfd0dff1e39ed52c811dc5204b43c7`.
The [official v6.12.0 tag](https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtbase.git/tag/?h=v6.12.0)
points to commit `025bdad181de241e81bf853c8a2d7bf3d19261a9`, matching the
deployed Qt kit's software bill of materials.

The Windows package places this directory at `licenses/open-source/qtbase-6.12.0/`.
Qt's supplied `licenses/qtbase-sbom.spdx.json` records component copyright notices
and license identifiers to read with these texts. This directory preserves the
source archive's full top-level license collection; the package contains the
runtime components listed in its deployment inventory.
